question: Should CodexBar add a permanent local “Share Stats” card export in both the status menu and Settings?
rationale: The implementation is technically reviewable, but VISION.md reserves new user-facing features and meaningful maintenance surface for explicit maintainer sign-off.

options.title: Approve local export
options.body: Keep the privacy-first preview, clipboard, and save workflow with no hosted profile, upload, or automatic pasteboard action.

options.title: Approve one entry point
options.body: Keep the export capability but expose it only from the status menu or Settings to reduce permanent UI surface.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Keep CodexBar focused on live provider status and omit the share-card workflow.

recommendation.title: Approve local export
recommendation.body: Keep the privacy-first preview, clipboard, and save workflow with no hosted profile, upload, or automatic pasteboard action.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner dominates recent history in the affected menu lifecycle and is the clearest owner for VISION.md product sign-off.
